healthcli imports your Apple Health export into a local SQLite database
and lets you log, review and query your data. Nothing leaves your machine.

Usage:
  healthcli [command]

Examples:
  healthcli import apple export.zip
  healthcli log weight 72.5
  healthcli today
  healthcli overview
  healthcli trend steps --days 30
  healthcli query "SELECT * FROM samples LIMIT 5" --json

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  heatmap     Calendar heatmap of one metric, one cell per day
  help        Help about any command
  import      Import data from another source
  log         Record a manual measurement
  overview    One-screen summary of every metric, sleep, workouts and data health
  query       Run a read-only SQL query
  sleep       Last night's sleep: hypnogram, stats against your usual, calendar
  today       Show a day's summary compared with your baseline
  trend       Show how a metric changes over the last days
  version     Print the healthcli version
  workouts    Workouts: type table, weekly volume, bests, recent sessions and a calendar

Flags:
      --db string   SQLite database path (default: per-user data dir)
  -h, --help        help for healthcli
      --json        output JSON instead of human-readable text

Use "healthcli [command] --help" for more information about a command.
